pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpentipi parimaddāpentipīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpessantipi parimaddāpessantipi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc90:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī bhikkhuniyā ummaddāpeyya vā parimaddāpeyya vā pācittiyanti.
